"8. Railway operations other than construction, operation and maintenance of the following: (i) suburban corridor projects through Public Private Partnership; (ii) - high speed train projects; (iii) dedicated freight lines; (iv) rolling stock including train sets, and locomotives or coach manufacturing and maintenance facilities; (v) railway electrification; (vi) signaling systems; (vii) freight terminals; (viii) passenger terminals; (ix) infrastructure in industrial park pertaining to railway line or sidings including electrified railway lines and connectivities to main railway line; and . (x) mass rapid transport systems". [F. No. 7(2)/20l4-IL(IP)'] SHUBHRA SINGH,Jt. Secy. Note: The Principal notification was published in the Gazette ofIndia, vide number S.O. 477(E), dated the 25th July, 1991 and last amended vide number S.O. 1881(E), dated the 30th July, 2010.
